description: This file defines functions to load test include patterns from environment variables and to create a Vitest test configuration specific to the 'feishu' extension, including environmental setup and test file patterns.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for tests from the environment variables, using a specified environment object or defaulting to process.env.

methods.name: export function createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig( createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration object tailored for the Feishu extension, setting up test patterns, environment, and configuration options.
